name: 机场入口批次防爆检测场景
description: 围合批次检测区；入口和出口接入可脱扣、回收、拉出扣回的柔性伸缩带套件
upstream_origin: FQ project-authored concept geometry and rendered signage
license_status: Project-authored environment; no robot, character, bag or third-party model payloads included. See NOTICE.md.
limitations: MuJoCo swab grasp requires bilateral pad contact, then an explicit weld; not friction-only grasp validation
Robot demo is kinematic IK with a concept tool extension and lateral base repositioning; motors, wheel traction and navigation not validated
Occupancy, alarm and release authorization are caller inputs; no Connection or chemical detector response
Prototype dimensions/mass/friction are uncalibrated; no personnel sampling/contact safety claim
Web catalog is a static preview; run Python controller for operations
MuJoCo 3.3.6 native 2D flex webbing only; USD and web 3D are static visual snapshots
Reel feed is a prescribed spiral boundary with rate limiting, not spring torque or motor dynamics
Grasp, docking and latch use checked explicit constraints; not friction-only manipulation or vendor latch replication
Internal webbing self-collision is disabled; reel-layer packing/friction is not validated
Dimensions, materials, masses and contact forces are assumed, not calibrated
Guide gripper fixture is included; no robot policy, perception or complete passenger workflow

viewer_summary.title: 机场入口 · 围合批次检测区
paragraphs: 旅客不摘包，分批进入，逐人擦拭人与包；批次结果满足条件后再打开出口。桌子和检测仪位于等待区域内。
入口和出口已接入柔性伸缩带套件：端头抬起脱扣、受控回收、拉出并下压扣回。网页默认播放入口的物理仿真录制，可切换静态外观。
当前视频由概念夹具操作，不含人员、机器人自主控制或完整安检业务；卷筒为受控收放边界。新柔性采样布与料盒尚未接入安检流程。

demonstration.caption: 原生 MuJoCo 柔性带轨迹在机场布局中的录制；出口保持扣合。使用概念夹具，尚未接入旅客与机器人流程。
